name: Hattusha: the Hittite Capital
description: Hattusha was the capital of the Hittite Empire, whose ruins lie near the village of Boğazkale in central Türkiye, inside a great bend of the Kızılırmak River. Visitors can walk among the remains of temples, royal residences and massive defensive walls, and pass through gateways carved with lions and other figures. Nearby, the open-air rock sanctuary of Yazılıkaya shows processions of gods carved into natural stone.
